text: A parasite is an organism that obtains its nutrients from another living organism (the host).
Fig. 2.1 shows the parasitic plant dodder, Cuscuta epithymum, growing on the host plant, gorse,
Ulex sp. The flowers and stems belong to the dodder. This plant does not have leaves or roots, and
obtains its nutrients and water from the gorse.
